snippet.title: CYBER-ASSASSIN™ Vengeance Demo | Brutal Hack & Slash and Executions Gameplay (HD 1080p 60fps)
snippet.description:
CYBER-ASSASSIN™: Vengeance Demo gameplay in HD!

This is a work-in-progress demo, showcasing the current build. Bugs, unpolished assets, and errors may be present. Enjoy the video!

CYBER-ASSASSIN™ is a brutal hack-and-slash game, inspired by Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance, classic God of War, Devil May Cry, and Ninja Gaiden.
Play as Kane, a cybernetic assassin who awakens inside a Zenith Corporation facility with no memory of who he was — only his raw, violent instincts survive.
In the Vengeance Demo, Kane must rely on sheer will, fury, and combat skill to fight his way out.
More of the story will be revealed in future updates

DOWNLOAD NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2612730/CYBERASSASSIN/

#cyberassassin #hackandslash #brutalcombat #godofwarlike #fastpacedgameplay 

Playing on ASUS ROG Strix G16 Gaming Laptop, AMD Ryzen 9 8940HX, GeForce RTX 5070 8GB, 16GB DDR5-5600, 2TB SSD

INSTAGRAM: https://www.instagram.com/_cyberwave_studios
TIK TOK: https://www.tiktok.com/@cyberassassin_game
YOUTUBE: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCzVTaNerD9qLibIjYEbe7dQ
